Manafall 0.1.36 - Windows client

What's new in 0.1.36
- Host / Join / Server / AutoJoin now activate the deferred NetworkManager before starting Mirror (fixes Host button no-op when NetworkManager.singleton was null on Menu Scene).
- Menu UI unsquash (PR #33): match monitor pixels / 1920x1080 scaler so ultrawide no longer stretches a 4:3 buffer; Play Offline gets a real raycast hit target; release menu night blackout so play view stays readable.

Still true from 0.1.35
- Windows desktop: phone touch overlay no longer appears on the main menu / Offline panel.
- Patch installer: ApplyPendingPatch-Now.cmd launch path so Quit cannot kill the installer; Desktop Manafall.exe starter restored on apply.
